claim_boundary: FAKE_DRIVER_TEST exercises software paths only. Gate metrics are derived from hash-locked fake opportunity tables, not field captures. This is not live hardware, an independent field campaign, a prospective installed action, an EO outcome, or evidence of candidate benefit. Field execution remains NOT_RUN.

threshold_rationale.calibration_gap_0.05: Maximum upper confidence bound on absolute task-relevant probability error; sensitivity at 0.025 and 0.10 must be reported.
threshold_rationale.canary_fraction_0.10: Conservative initial exposure cap. It is a staged safety allocation, not a coefficient learned from outcomes.
threshold_rationale.ci_half_width_0.05: Precision target for the candidate-minus-baseline completion effect; the blinded pilot may increase the sample size.
threshold_rationale.feature_coverage_0.95: At most five percent of required decision features may be unavailable before fail-closed fallback.
threshold_rationale.first_packet_timeout_500_ms: Draft operational timeout for the first verified post-installation packet. Replace with the application SLO before protocol freeze.
threshold_rationale.five_gate_campaigns_three_families: A conservative eligibility profile that supports one leave-one-campaign-out cycle and limits reliance on one acquisition pipeline. It is not a universal minimum; the blinded pilot power and precision calculation may require more.
threshold_rationale.loop_budget_100_ms: Existing sub-100-ms control-loop engineering target; it must be confirmed against the deployed application and hardware before protocol freeze.
threshold_rationale.noninferiority_minus_0.02: A loss larger than two percentage points in the primary completion endpoint is declared operationally unacceptable; this margin requires supervisor and operator approval before registration.
threshold_rationale.ood_fraction_0.10: An engineering fallback budget selected before testing; sensitivity at 0.05 and 0.20 must be reported.
